response.sql: SELECT c.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation c2 JOIN sites s2 ON c2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) AS fraction FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, c.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10
